summary: Researchers introduced MQT Bench with more than 70,000 circuits spanning 2 to 130 qubits and four abstraction levels.
quote: By comprising more than 70,000 benchmark circuits ranging from 2 to 130 qubits on four abstraction levels, MQT Bench presents a first step towards benchmarking different abstraction levels with a single benchmark suite to increase comparability, reproducibility, and transparency.
